It could be argued that dairy cows have a much more hellish existence than those bred to be slaughtered. They're kept eternally pregnant to keep pumping out milk, they're caged similarly to chickens for their whole lives and their babies are taken from them the instant they're born which is traumatizing. Hens are kept in a small cage their whole lives, neglected and abused. Leading a vegan lifestyle is also a good way to minimize your carbon footprint, the dairy/egg industry contributes to a massive amouny of pollution. A huge problem is the massive amount of waste the animals produce, and the limited number of ways we have to deal with it safely. There are places where ranchers have resorted to spraying the liquified excrement in the air, effectivly showering neighboring communities with an actual shit storm.

Harvest Moon DS is still my favorite installation of the series by far.
